$comment: Map layers and historical map viewers. Overlays are WMS services requested in Web Mercator (EPSG:3857); set enabled to false for a service that does not deliver aligned images (task 5.1 of add-map-core). Viewer URLs may contain {name} for the Municipality name. The app sends no Referer (Referrer-Policy: no-referrer), but OpenStreetMap's tile policy requires one: the base layer's referrerPolicy strict-origin sends the app's origin with its tiles, never a path. The server allows the hosts of the base and overlay URLs in the app's Content-Security-Policy.
